archive-member-count.description: Number of file members in the KMZ archive, excluding directory entries.

attachment.description: Original KML XML or complete KMZ archive, including packaged assets.

coordinate-count.description: Number of parsed geometry positions, including line and polygon vertices and nonempty gx:Track samples.

description-text.description: Description of the entry document or root feature.

end-time.description: Latest complete timezone-qualified timestamp among extracted observations.

entry-document.description: Path of the main KML document inside the KMZ archive.

geometry-type.description: Geometry types parsed in Placemarks, including gx:Track and gx:MultiTrack.

max-latitude.description: Maximum WGS84 latitude among parsed geometry positions.

max-longitude.description: Maximum WGS84 longitude among parsed geometry positions.

md5.description: MD5 hash of the original attachment.

mime-type.description: application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml for KML or application/vnd.google-earth.kmz for KMZ.

min-latitude.description: Minimum WGS84 latitude among parsed geometry positions.

min-longitude.description: Minimum WGS84 longitude among parsed geometry positions.

name.description: Name of the entry document or root feature.

observation-count.description: Number of extracted Point and nonempty gx:Track observations; repeated positions remain distinct.

placemark-count.description: Number of Placemarks parsed in the entry document and locally linked KML members; each document is parsed once.

sha1.description: SHA1 hash of the original attachment.

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the original attachment.

size-in-bytes.description: Size of the original KML file or compressed KMZ archive in bytes.

source-format.description: Container format of the attached dataset.

start-time.description: Earliest complete timezone-qualified timestamp among extracted observations.

text.description: Analyst note about the dataset; altitude modes and source feature metadata remain in linked observation context and the attachment.

description: A KML geographic dataset or KMZ package, preserving its original document and assets, file provenance, geometry counts and derived bounds. Link extracted Point and gx:Track observations using contains.
name: kml
